visual.description: Camera zoomed into space between USA and Denmark. All other dots fade to 20% opacity. Connector line between USA and Denmark reappears. Gap labeled: '439 hours | 55 days | 6%.' The numbers pulse. Greece and Mexico flash briefly in TRAP (0.3s glow + fade). Final text: 'What is an hour of your life worth?' fades in below matrix. Then slow fade to #1A1B22 black. Channel watermark appears. Hold 3-5s silence for YouTube end screen area.

textOverlay.finalQuestion: What is an hour of your life worth?

notes: Emotional close. The zoom into USA-Denmark gap is the visual metaphor for the entire video: same destination, different paths. '439 hours | 55 days | 6%' pulses in JetBrains Mono. Greece/Mexico flash is a brief callback — the extremes haven't been forgotten. 'What is an hour of your life worth?' in Inter, subtle fade over 2s. No 'like and subscribe' — the silence is the CTA. YouTube end screen elements in last 20s. Channel watermark appears after fade to black. EndCardScene is a new component needed.
